name: design-decisions-sweep
brief: Close the 10 Design-decisions lines of .sir/backlog.md. The user rules on each at Gate 2 from re-measured evidence. Draft rulings: restore PanelBar's re-click-to-close, routed through the guarded requestClose so a dirty Helm draft raises the close confirmation; promote crossSessionInbound 'hold' to a confirmed value (CLI 2.1.318 declares accept/hold/refuse) and delete the hold warning, the caveat and the confirmed-subset constant, re-citing 2.1.318; close the palette lightness pass as accepted (only three sub-1.2 pairs share a surface, and colour is never the only carrier); keep Calf steering, the config manager, terminal-session adoption and macOS/Linux validation deferred; re-file forkSession as its own session; decline the raw terminal pane and the formatter. Five tasks run in one chain: T1 PanelBar, T2 main-process Helm validation, T3 renderer Helm, T4 the frozen-contract edits, T5 repo-wide tsc and full vitest. The backlog edit is the orchestrator's at Gate 3.
